title: spartina juncea subvar. americana
intro: Spartina juncea subvar. americana, commonly known as American cordgrass, is a perennial grass native to North America. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as reducing inflammation, lowering blood pressure, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of American cordgrass include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and diuretic properties, which can aid in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
